data.summary:
**When:** Any phase, after one of your **INFANTRY REGIMENT** units is **destroyed**.

**Target:** That **INFANTRY REGIMENT** unit, despite its destruction.

**Effect:** Add to your army a new unit identical to the destroyed one, placed in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves), with its full [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models) and every wound remaining.

**Restrictions:** Once per battle. It cannot return a destroyed **CHARACTER** unit to an [Attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units).
